name: S&P 500 Top 20 Weekly Losers
description: Identifies the 20 worst performing S&P 500 stocks over the last week and displays key technical metrics including weekly return, position relative to 50-day MA, days since 52-week high, and days since all-time high
source:
# S&P 500 Top 20 Weekly Losers
# Identifies worst performers with key technical metrics

# Data source
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# 1-week return (5 trading days)
weekly_return = returns(period=5, type=ReturnsType.simple)(close)

# 50-day moving average
ma_50 = ma(period=50)(close)

# Price vs MA (percentage above/below)
price_vs_ma = (close - ma_50) / ma_50

# 52-week high (252 trading days)
high_52w = max(period=252)(close)
at_52w_high = close >= high_52w
days_since_52w_high = barssince()(at_52w_high)

# All-time high - using large period (10 years = 2520 trading days)
high_all_time = max(period=2520)(close)
at_ath = close >= high_all_time
days_since_ath = barssince()(at_ath)

# Select bottom 20 by weekly return
is_bottom_20 = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.bottom, mode=CSSelectMode.count, k=20)(weekly_return)

# Display table with assets as rows and metrics as columns
cs_summary_table(
    title="Top 20 S&P 500 Worst Weekly Performers",
    category="Analysis",
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    max_assets=20,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title="1-Week Return %", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Current Price", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="50-Day MA", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Price vs MA %", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Days Since 52W High", type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(title="Days Since ATH", type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(weekly_return, close, ma_50, price_vs_ma, days_since_52w_high, days_since_ath, is_bottom_20)
